title: Orthogonal Projections & Gram-Schmidt
summary: Shadows, nearest points, projection matrices, orthonormal bases.

title: Linear Regression
summary: Normal equations, geometry (the fit is a projection!), why more features never raise training error, least squares = Gaussian MLE, gradient descent, Gauss-Markov.
figs: F2.1 | Fit as projection | 3D: y, column space of X, ŷ and residual; drag y.
F2.2 | Adding features | Slider adds columns; residual length only shrinks.
F2.3 | Gaussian noise gives squared loss | Points with vertical Gaussian bumps; switch to Laplace to see absolute loss.
F2.4 | Gradient descent on a bowl | Contours, step-size slider, divergence demo.
F2.5 | Gauss-Markov | Estimate clouds for OLS vs another unbiased estimator.

title: MLE vs MAP, Ridge & Lasso
summary: Priors as regularizers: Gaussian prior → Ridge, Laplace prior → Lasso. Why Lasso gives sparsity.
figs: F3.1 | MLE vs MAP | Likelihood curve × prior curve = posterior; move prior width.
F3.2 | Ridge vs Lasso constraint | Loss ellipses touching a circle vs a diamond (sparsity at corners).
F3.3 | Coefficient paths | λ slider shrinks weights; Lasso hits zero, Ridge doesn't.

title: Bias–Variance Tradeoff & the Eigenvalue View
summary: Test error = bias² + variance + noise; OLS vs Ridge variance via eigenvalues; E[train] < E[test].
figs: F4.1 | Dartboard | The 4 bias/variance quadrants; resample training sets and watch weight estimates scatter.
F4.2 | Model complexity curve | Degree slider: train/test error, U-shape.
F4.3 | Ridge shrinks per eigen-direction | Ellipse of XᵀX with factor dᵢ/(dᵢ+λ).
F4.4 | Variance floor | See Ch 8: averaging reduces variance only to ρσ².

title: Logistic Regression
summary: Why log-odds (Bernoulli natural parameter), BCE = negative log-likelihood, no closed form, convexity, Newton/IRLS, linear decision boundary.
figs: F5.1 | Why not a straight line | Line vs sigmoid on 0/1 data.
F5.2 | Sigmoid & log-odds | Slider for p, shows odds and log-odds.
F5.3 | BCE loss surface | Convex bowl in (w,b).
F5.4 | GD vs Newton | Same loss, iteration counts side by side.
F5.5 | Decision boundary | Drag points; wᵀx=0 line moves.

title: Support Vector Machines
summary: Geometric margin, hard → soft margin (hinge loss), Lagrangian dual & KKT, kernels & Mercer, SVR.
figs: F6.1 | Distance to hyperplane | Drag x₀; see signed distance.
F6.2 | Max margin | Rotate boundary; margin width and support vectors update.
F6.3 | Slack variables | Slide C; margin violators light up.
F6.4 | Hinge vs log loss | Overlaid curves.
F6.5 | Kernel trick | 1D data lifted to 2D with φ(x)=(x,x²).
F6.6 | RBF γ | Decision boundary vs γ.
F6.7 | SVR ε-tube | Points inside tube cost zero.

title: Decision Trees
summary: Entropy, information gain (≥0 via Jensen), Gini; greedy splitting ⇒ high variance.
figs: F7.1 | Entropy & Gini curves | Binary p from 0 to 1.
F7.2 | Split explorer | Click a threshold, see IG.
F7.3 | Tree depth vs boundary | Overfitting live.

title: Bagging & Random Forest
summary: Var = σ²[ρ + (1−ρ)/B]: why decorrelating trees matters.
figs: F8.1 | Bootstrap sampling | Draw samples, see ~63% unique.
F8.2 | Variance vs B | Slider for ρ; floor at ρσ².

title: Gradient Boosting
summary: Gradient descent in function space; residuals = negative gradient of MSE; logistic-loss version.
figs: F9.1 | Boosting rounds | Add trees one by one; fit approaches the curve.
F9.2 | Residual = −gradient | MSE case.

title: AdaBoost
summary: Exponential loss, α = ½ ln((1−err)/err), weight updates, training-error bound; special case of gradient boosting.
figs: F10.1 | Sample weights | Misclassified points grow each round.
F10.2 | α vs error | Curve; flips sign past 0.5.
F10.3 | Ensemble boundary | Stumps combine.

title: XGBoost
summary: Second-order (Newton) boosting, regularized objective, optimal leaf weights, split-gain formula.
figs: F11.1 | Taylor approximation | Loss vs 2nd-order parabola.
F11.2 | Split gain | Pick split; see G_L,H_L,G_R,H_R and gain, γ pruning.

title: K-Means
summary: Distortion objective, assignment and mean updates, init sensitivity, elbow.
figs: F12.1 | K-Means step by step | Assign / update buttons.
F12.2 | Bad init | Different seeds, different answers.
F12.3 | Elbow plot | J vs k.

title: Latent Variables & the EM Algorithm
summary: Why log-of-sum blocks closed form; E-step (responsibilities), M-step (expected complete-data log-likelihood); Jensen link; K-Means as hard EM.
figs: F13.1 | Jensen's inequality | Chord below concave curve.
F13.2 | EM as lower-bound climbing | Bound touches likelihood then lifts it.
F13.3 | Hard vs soft | Same point, one-hot vs probabilities.

title: Gaussian Mixture Models
summary: Mixture density, one-hot latent z, responsibilities, closed-form μ, Σ, π updates (π via Lagrange).
figs: F14.1 | GMM fitting | Ellipses move each EM iteration.
F14.2 | Responsibility colors | Points blend between components.
F14.3 | Update intuition | μ = weighted mean, Σ = weighted covariance, π = fraction.
